HALLOW INU

HOW TO PLAY

Run through the haunted trenches on three lanes. Switch lanes, jump and slide past haunted wagons, graves and cursed candles. A skeleton and his bone dog are right behind you — bump into something twice and they catch you.

CONTROLS

  • ← Move left
  • → Move right
  • SPACE Jump
  • ↓ Duck / slide
  • P/ESC Pause
  • Mobile: swipe ← → ↑ ↓ or tap the buttons

COINS

  • HALLOWINU +1 point · most common
  • USDC +5 points · rarer, harder spots
  • SOLANA +10 points · very rare, tricky to reach

OBSTACLES

  • Graves, pumpkins, low walls, mine carts → JUMP or switch
  • Chains, branches, floating ghosts → SLIDE or switch
  • Haunted wagons & bear candles → SWITCH LANE
  • Moving wagons drive towards you — react fast!

POINTS

Your coin points are verified by the server. They become pending when a run ends and are redeemed automatically into your HALLOWINU account when you start your next run. Unlimited runs, no energy, no tickets. Connect Phantom to earn.
